title: Doesn't heat anywhere near fast enough
text:
Doesn't heat anywhere near fast enough. Takes 7 minutes just to make instant ramen, doesn't cook microwaved popcorn properly (ignoring the fact that popcorn button is useless), and in general is just too weak for my liking. The only thing it does better than my previous microwave is not burn things, and that's largely because it's too weak to do that unless you were to leave something in for hours.

There's also an unsettling clicking sound if you've got it running for more than a few minutes.
